description:
Hi, I'm Tom Brennan...
I spent 31 years on a small-town fire department in Ohio, and the calls I remember most were never the big fires. They were the quiet winter ones: a space heater too close to a bed, a grill brought inside during an outage, a candle under a flowerpot because somebody saw it online.

I'm retired now and I live alone in an old farmhouse, same as a lot of you. This channel is where I test the winter tricks you see online, tell you straight which ones work and which ones are dangerous, and show you the cheap, safe way to stay warm, keep the lights on and get through a blackout on your own.

New videos uploaded regularly.

Subscribe if you want to get through the next winter storm warm and safe, the way an old firefighter would.

videos.title: 9 Things You Don't Have to Pay For After 60 (A Retired Firefighter's List)
How to Stay Warm When the Power Goes Out (10 Ways, Deadly to Safe)
